Hi Jess, my name's Richard (Feel free to call me Rick though).
I'm interested in the room you have that's currently up for rent.
I spent some time up in Brisbane earlier in the year, and am looking to return on a more permanent basis.
I'm currently in East Gippsland, in Victoria, so unfortunately I can't meet with you and view the room in person.
I'm quite content with what I've seen and read about your home online.
I think it would be a perfect space for me to settle into life, back in Brisbane.
If a viewing is required. Could we tee up something virtually?
Please feel free to take a look at my profile, and see if I could be a good fit for you and your household.
If you have any questions, or need any further information about me, please don't hesitate to get in touch.
I hope to hear from you.
Kind regards, Rick.
